description: This file contains utility functions for managing and checking permissions for vector store endpoints in a FastAPI application, including permission validation, endpoint matching, and access control for vector store and vector store file endpoints.

methods.name: _does_endpoint_match
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint path matches the request path, considering path parameters.

methods.name: check_vector_store_permission
methods.description: Verifies if a given API key or team has permission for a specific vector store index and permission type.

methods.name: is_allowed_to_call_vector_store_endpoint
methods.description: Determines if a user API key has permission to call a specific vector store endpoint based on request method and URL.

methods.name: is_allowed_to_call_vector_store_files_endpoint
methods.description: Determines if a user API key has permission to call a specific vector store file endpoint based on request method and URL.
